column6: A whimsical track with an almost robotic tone.
A sinister, dark theme that makes use of various instruments to evoke a sound akin to the echoes of a deep dungeon below.
It has a different, less whimsical feel than the original Underground theme. It also contains a Boss 2 motif near the end of the song.
A heroic-sounding track which features violin. Its internal name is "Music-Main Theme (Underground)" which suggests it was meant as a title screen track, which in turn fits with its grand intro.
It is a melancholic and ritualistic-feeling track which features chanting and tribal-like drums.
